options: Post-monsoon rain especially important to parts of southern peninsular India

questions.question_en: Which description correctly identifies Cyclone rainfall hazard?
questions.question_te: తుఫాను వర్ష ప్రమాదం గురించి సరైన వివరణ/సంబంధం ఏది?

Physiological burden influenced by temperature, humidity, exposure and vulnerability
Abnormal sea-level rise driven mainly by storm winds and pressure
Heavy precipitation and winds from organised tropical cyclonic systems

ఈ వివరణ ఉష్ణ ఒత్తిడి (Heat stress)కు చెందినది. తుఫాను వర్ష ప్రమాదంకు సరైన సంబంధం: Heavy precipitation and winds from organised tropical cyclonic systems.
ఈ వివరణ తుఫాను సముద్ర ఉద్ధృతి (Storm surge)కు చెందినది. తుఫాను వర్ష ప్రమాదంకు సరైన సంబంధం: Heavy precipitation and winds from organised tropical cyclonic systems.

questions.question_en: Why should cyclone preparedness extend beyond the expected landfall point?
questions.question_te: Cyclone preparedness landfall point దాటి ఎందుకు ఉండాలి?
options: Rivers cannot flood during cyclones
Only the eye receives any weather
Storm tracks are perfectly certain
Rain, wind and surge impacts extend over wider and differing areas
option_explanations: Heavy rain can produce river floods.
The eye is not the entire storm.
Track/intensity forecasts have uncertainty.
Hazards have distinct footprints and forecast uncertainty.

questions.question_en: Which is the safer basis for rainfed sowing decisions?
questions.question_te: Rainfed sowingకు ఏ basis మంచిది?
options: One isolated shower regardless of subsequent conditions
Established soil moisture and expected follow-up rain, with crop suitability
Assume all AP soils retain the same water
Only the annual national average
option_explanations: An isolated shower can be followed by damaging dry spells.
Establishment and subsequent supply affect germination and survival.
Soil storage varies.
National totals do not specify local timing.

questions.question_en: What is wrong with treating a station rainfall figure as every village's rainfall?
questions.question_te: Station rainను అన్ని villagesకు sameగా తీసుకోవడంలో లోపం?
options: It ignores spatial variability and the representativeness of the observation
Administrative borders force uniform rain
Rain cannot vary within districts
Stations measure only ocean waves
option_explanations: A point measurement and an area distribution are different.
Weather does not follow political boundaries.
Rainfall varies spatially.
Rain gauges measure precipitation.
